caption: Average performance of different models on the November 2024 AMC-10 and AMC-12 tests. This is the average score (with maximum score 150) over the four tests on 100 runs with temperature t=0.5. We chose t = 0.5 to follow simple-evals <cit.>. Error bars are 2 of the estimate. On competition math, scores well above its weight-class even compared to non–open-weight models.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average performance scores of several language models on November 2024 AMC-10/12 tests, with the value axis representing “Average score (temperature = 0.5)” ranging from 66.4 to 91.8, and marked with tick intervals of 5, utilizing a linear scale. The horizontal axis displays the names of the models, ordered alphabetically: “Llama-3.3 70B Instruct,” “Claude 3.5 14b-Instruct,” “Sonnet,” “Qwen 2.5 14b-Instruct,” “Qwen 2.5,” “GPT 40-mini,” “GPT,” “Qwen 2.5,” “Gemini Flash 1.5,” “Gemini Pro 1.5,” and “phi-4.”  The chart presents the average performance for each model as a colored bar; the “Large model” (represented by green bars) shows an average score of approximately 89.8, with a minimum value of 77.4 and a maximum value of 91.8, while the “Small model” (represented by blue bars) exhibits an average score of approximately 77.9, with a minimum value of 66.4 and a maximum value of 81.6. The “Gemini” bars are visually emphasized with a darker shade; “Gemini” has an average score of 78.7, and “phi-4” an average score of 89.2, with error bars extending from each bar.
